dimensions.assessment: Affects physicians, healthcare providers, and Medicare beneficiaries reimbursed under the Medicare physician fee schedule.
dimensions.evidence: delay the implementation of an efficiency adjustment to work relative value units under the Medicare physician fee schedule

dimensions.assessment: Delays efficiency adjustments and adjusts conversion factor updates for qualifying and nonqualifying APM participants.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may not implement the policy... that establishes an efficiency adjustment to work relative value units... before January 1, 2030.

dimensions.assessment: Alters Medicare physician fee schedule updates and conversion factor percentages (modifying figures from 0.75 to 1.24 percent and 0.25 to 0.74 percent).
dimensions.evidence: by striking `0.75 percent' and inserting `1.24 percent'... by striking `0.25 percent' and inserting `0.74 percent'

dimensions.assessment: Amends title XVIII of the Social Security Act to restrict Medicare administrative rulemaking and adjust payment formulas.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1848(c) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395w-4(c)) is amended by adding at the end the following new paragraph

dimensions.assessment: Imposes a delay effective through 2030 and permanent adjustments to subsequent year conversion factor updates.
dimensions.evidence: before January 1, 2030... For 2027 and each subsequent year, the update... is 0.75 percent
